body.statement: For every law \(P\), consistency and event-date counterfactual transport alone imply \(\tau(z_0)=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\{\mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0]-m_s(z_{0s})\}\).
body.justification: This isolates causal identification from the estimation frontier and keeps the target a level-wealth contrast rather than a return approximation.
body.gap: Ferman (2021) obtains factor-loading recovery for synthetic controls; it does not identify this nonlinear realized-path wealth regression functional.
body.consumer: Financial event studies can report an interpretable dollar-wealth effect while using rolling untreated pseudo-events only to diagnose or falsify pre-event stability, not to verify event-date transport.
